message:
Integrate DEV and avoid unsupported-scene transport memory (T-3088)

Integrate accepted DEV ce91 while preserving the occupied transport assets,
named identities, interaction fixes, license entries and accepted night
lighting. Resolve the shared bootstrap imports and use only the native
liberties/source-use owners; no feedback or research rebaseline.

Avoid loading the town-transport graph in unsupported scenes. Use byte
buffers for count-only flora inputs and exact byte/Float16 timber scalars,
with native CPU and paired GPU controls. Release static railway
matrix copies after upload and replay rocks/gray colors exactly on demand.
Preserve shapes, imagery, quality settings and all production ceilings. The matching Chromium141
1812 and 1904 mobile memory readings both pass on this source.

All four fresh native source parts must pass before this commit. Actual
committed-head checks follow. Remote CI and real world interaction results
remain separate merge requirements; old world failures are not promoted.
Broad photographic, gait, boarding and riding tickets remain open.
